env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
# Pin the default experiment set: the harness passes ambient GOEXPERIMENT
# through, so an inherited nojsonv2 would fail the default run below.
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd variants

# A known experiment next to an unknown one: the unknown tag must not
# poison the synthesized GOEXPERIMENT values. Eject must lower the
# inactive variant under a context that selects it.
logos run .
stdout '^default jsonv2$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-default.txt

env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2
logos run .
stdout '^default nojsonv2$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-off.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/a_v1.go
exists out/a_v2.go
grep 'goexperiment.jsonv2' out/a_v1.go
grep 'goexperiment.swissmap' out/a_v1.go
grep 'goexperiment.jsonv2' out/a_v2.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-default.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-off.txt

-- variants/go.mod --
module example.com/unknownexperiment

go 1.27

-- variants/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(which()) }

-- variants/a_v1.lgo --
//go:build !goexperiment.jsonv2 && !goexperiment.swissmap

package main

func which() string { return "default nojsonv2" }

-- variants/a_v2.lgo --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2

package main

func which() string { return "default jsonv2" }
